checkMessages: Browse uses the isolated demo folder.
Create writes and opens the requested RTF.
Save clears dirty state after writing.
Reopening the saved file retains the entered text.
F1 from the editor opens modeless help owned by MainWindow.
Repeated opening restores a minimized window.
Planned target preserves article and history.
Whitespace query returns the contents tree.
Culture change clears search and preserves topic.
Help preserves both documents, dirty revisions, selection, AI messages/input and main navigation.
Localized Help menu entry is available.
Menu reuses the existing Help window.
Markdown syntax opens separate help without replacing the main page.
Escape clears the focused help search.
F1 inside Help preserves the current topic.
Article text and images reflow without scrolling the entire page horizontally.
Embedded localized image loads without repository file reads.
Last topic survives close and reopen.
All registered persistent stores are inside the validation root.
captureMethod: RenderTargetBitmap of visible production WPF windows
interaction: production ICommand/ViewModel and storage services, plus routed keyboard events
limitations: No physical keyboard/mouse or installed-user migration test. Folder-picker shortcut supplies the demo folder; stage4 also exercises the real WPF folder picker.
